sponges text index | photo index Phylum Porifera Brownie sponge
Hyattella tubaria***Family Spongiidaeupdated Oct 2016

Where seen? This rather untidy sponge is sometimes seen on some of our Nothern and Southern shores. Features: Untidy lumpy mass, or thick irregular branches (10-15cm), porous. Surface lumpy and crumbly looking, resembling brownies. Colour greyish brown.


Terumbu Raya, Jul 12


Chek Jawa, Aug 13

*Species are difficult to positively identify without close examination.
On this website, they are grouped by external features for convenience of display.
